title: Basically a small bumper car
text: Basically a small bumper car. We have had this for a year and a half now so I can definitely do a decent review. I hate this thing! It has no idea where it’s going. After just 3 months it was so beat up. It’s basically a small bumper car. It just bumps off of something and goes the other way and misses half of the house. It gets stuck in the middle of the room for no reason. I haven’t tried the mopping feature but I imagine it won’t work well either. Trashing this one and buying another brand.
